places.name: The Skyward Towers
places.epithet: Three tall spires rooted firmly in stone
places.text: The anchors of the floating Loom: they house the anchor-runes, lift-wards and harassed clerks whose task is to make sure the sky-bound part of Skyloom stays attached to the rest. From The Crown, one reaches the Loom by way of them.

places.name: The Loom's Shadow
places.epithet: Shopkeepers set their clocks by it
places.text: Every afternoon the shadow of the Loom, floating above, crosses the town end to end. Buildings here are low and broad so as not to foul the lift-wards, so nothing stands tall enough to be lit while the rest is dark.

places.name: The Warden's Court
places.epithet: Where the Weave Warden holds court
places.text: The seat of the Weave Warden of Skyloom, at the edge of the tower plazas.

places.name: The Lift-Seal Office
places.text: Where lift-seals are issued: the permits without which nobody rides the Skyward Towers up to the Groundring.

places.name: The Loom Stores
places.epithet: Cheese, liquor, and a great many candles
places.text: Where the Loom's own needs are gathered before being sent up: cheese, liquor, and a great many candles.

places.name: The Cloudwine Distilleries
places.epithet: Drunk mostly by people who have just come down
places.text: Distilleries that make cloudwine, a clear, cold spirit.

places.name: The Tower Plazas
places.text: Central District's plazas cluster round the roots of the Skyward Towers.

places.name: The Loom Road
places.text: East through the Loomward stormgate to The Crown.

places.name: The Sapphire Road
places.text: West through Midhurstnes, Castfield and Clitford toward Cloudmoor Harbor.
